pump-add.note: the violet badge sits on the right edge of the ring and covers the outlet side; the 16 px variant keeps ring, outlet and plus

valve-remove.note: the badge covers the right triangle's tip; the 16 px variant keeps the bow-tie and the minus

network-add.note: all three nodes stay visible; the badge covers part of the right branch

device-connected.note: the badge overlaps the right prong and body; the check is small at 16 px

save-done.note: the badge overlaps the right side of the floppy; the check is small at 16 px

alarm-list-clear.note: the badge covers the right side of the bell; the minus stays readable in the 16 px variant
